Carnero Bravo 2023 The Forest Filtration of a Graph Theorem 33
correctness.rationale: The complete-bipartite induced-forest complex is the union of two contractible joins with intersection the 1-dimensional K_{a,b}, so Mayer–Vietoris gives H2 canonically identified with H1(K_{a,b}) and simple connectivity. Missing xy admits tetrahedra on {x,u,y,v}; their boundaries map to fundamental four-cycles of the explicit double-star spanning tree. Those cycles form an integral basis, not merely a mod-two spanning family, and kill H2 without changing the 2-skeleton. For one deletion no further faces arise, the relative 3-cell attachment is a unimodular isomorphism, and simply connected acyclicity yields contractibility. For K3,3 minus two independent edges, the given f-vector and a primitive pair of top boundaries yield integral H3=Z; Hurewicz and Whitehead imply S3. Independently enumerated every bipartite graph on (2,2),(2,3),(3,3), checked F2 reduced homology and the two-deletion face vector. The integral conclusions rely on the spanning-tree proof, not mod-two checks.
residual_risks: The check is mod two only; torsion and integral generators are addressed analytically.
Higher homotopy groups for arbitrary proper bipartite graphs are not classified.

originality.rationale: Carnero Bravo proves the complete-bipartite wedge and girth-based connectivity; those are prior and credited. The girth-four inequality yields only 1-connectivity, not the new universal 2-connectivity for a proper bipartite spanning subgraph, and no one-edge contractibility theorem appears in the primary relevant sections. Other bipartite missing-edge enumerators count induced forests, not homotopy. These comparisons support a qualified best-knowledge originality pass.

checked_sources: Carnero Bravo forest filtration as the motivating family
value.rationale: The induced-forest complex is a natural object in graph-complex topology. The theorem gives a sharp, all-size homotopy transition under the smallest possible edge perturbation, with a canonical integral cell-attachment mechanism and a two-deletion S3 boundary. This is a useful structural lemma rather than arbitrary enumeration.
residual_risks: No complete homotopy classification for all proper bipartite graphs is asserted.

limitations: Only finite simple bipartite graphs with both shore sizes at least two.
The new universal conclusion is 2-connectivity; some high-girth cases have stronger earlier bounds.
Higher homology outside one-edge and sharpness examples remains open.
